description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's first ability by paying {G} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur and The Gitrog Monster's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Surly Badgersaur trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gitrog Monster trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to gain three life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
